scopeLabel: All nine admitted main-paper pages were actually read as text and images. This source-scoped extraction covers the typical PbS synthesis, seven ligand exchanges, thermal and XRR film branches, characterization, reported comparisons and explicitly separate model interpretations. SI and cited upstream procedures are not admitted or imported. Unreported settings and exact physical batch joins remain unknown.

availability.morphology_illustration: Measured source figures and reported specimen facts are retained. No finite particle, device cross-section or atomic arrangement is reconstructed from incomplete geometry or unknown physical batch identity. Optional bulk PbS reference selection is restricted to the named XRD context.

bindings.caption: Record reported diameter groups and qualitative size control. The authors varied OA:ODE ratio and report that a higher OA concentration produced larger diameters. Exact ratios for each group are not provided. This operation records source context, not a reproduced experiment. Qualified action illustration; no unreported apparatus dimensions, atmosphere, time, measured atomic geometry or experimental trace is implied.

general_background.title: Thermodynamics and kinetics
general_background.summary: Thermodynamics describes which states are energetically favoured, while kinetics governs how quickly a system can move between them. A change can be favourable yet proceed slowly when an activation barrier or limited transport restricts the pathway.
